props.gloss_en: R' Chanan: even if the master of dreams tells a man 'tomorrow you die', he should not hold himself back from [praying for] mercy
R' Chanan's source: 'for in the multitude of dreams and vanities there are many words; but fear God' (Eccl 5:6)
immediately: 'and Hezekiah turned his face to the wall and prayed to the Lord' (Isa 38:2)
Reish Lakish: 'wall' -- [he prayed] from the chambers (kirot) of his heart
Reish Lakish's source: 'my bowels, my bowels, I writhe; the chambers (kirot) of my heart' (Jer 4:19)
R' Levi: 'wall' -- he spoke about matters of the wall (the Shunamite's wall against Solomon's Temple)
Hezekiah's prayer: 'remember now that I walked before You in truth and with a whole heart, and the good in Your eyes I did' (Isa 38:3)
Rav (via Rav Yehuda): 'the good in Your eyes I did' -- that he joined redemption to prayer
R' Levi: 'the good in Your eyes I did' -- that he hid away the Book of Remedies
the baraita: King Hezekiah did six things; on three they agreed with him and on three they did not
he hid away the Book of Remedies -- and they agreed with him
he crushed the copper serpent -- and they agreed with him
he dragged his father's bones on a bed of ropes -- and they agreed with him
he stopped up the waters of Gichon -- and they did not agree with him
he cut off the Heichal doors and sent them to the king of Assyria -- and they did not agree with him
he intercalated Nisan in Nisan -- and they did not agree with him
'this month shall be for you the first of months' (Ex 12:2): this one is Nisan and no other is Nisan
rather, he erred in Shmuel's rule: what the baraita calls intercalating Nisan in Nisan was intercalating on the thirtieth of Adar, the day fit to be Nisan
Shmuel: one does not intercalate the year on the thirtieth day of Adar
Shmuel's reason: since that day is fit to be fixed as [the first of] Nisan
the principle 'since it is fit [to be Nisan, treat it as Nisan]' is said -- which Hezekiah, on the stam's account, held is NOT said

schemas.gloss_en: R' Levi's account of Hezekiah's prayer: ומה שונמית שלא עשתה אלא קיר אחת קטנה החיית את בנה, אבי אבא שחפה את ההיכל כולו בכסף ובזהב על אחת כמה וכמה -- if the Shunamite's one small wall earned her son's revival, the Heichal covered in silver and gold earns all the more [Hezekiah's own]

objections.gloss_en: ומי לית ליה לחזקיהו החדש הזה לכם ראש חדשים -- זה ניסן ואין אחר ניסן?! how could Hezekiah have intercalated Nisan in Nisan, when the verse fixes Nisan as one month and no other?

answered_by.gloss_en: אלא טעה בדשמואל -- he erred in Shmuel's rule: he intercalated on the thirtieth of Adar, which is fit to be Nisan; Shmuel forbids it for that reason, and Hezekiah held that 'since it is fit' is not said (= p_taah_bedishmuel)
